latest.title: Minha primeira semana como Líder Estudantil Builder AWS: o que eu aprendi
latest.description:
Sou aluno de engenharia na UTFPR de Ponta Grossa. Antes do programa, eu era a mesma pessoa que entrava no Bloco de Engenharia carregando café e a mesma dúvida silenciosa de muito colega: "o que eu estudo aqui dentro vira trabalho de verdade lá fora?".
Eu já tinha ouvido falar de AWS, mas pra mim era uma palavra distante, do mundo da empresa grande. Não era pra estudante. Pelo menos era assim que eu enxergava.

latest.title: From Germany to Cameroon: One Trip, Every Hat, and a Room Full of Future Cloud Engineers
latest.description: When I stood before over 30 aspiring DevOps engineers in Cameroon, I saw something no slide deck could capture. I saw hunger. I saw curiosity. I saw a room full of young people who had already decided that their future would be built on cloud technology. They just needed someone to show them the path.  And it was one of the most fulfilling moments of my entire AWS Community Builder journey.

latest.description: Aqui compartilho como saí do zero em cloud até minha primeira entrevista técnica usando apenas recursos gratuitos da AWS, com foco em trilhas de estudo e pequenos projetos.

latest.title: 🚀 Começando do Zero na AWS: Meu Primeiro Passo no Mundo Cloud
latest.description:
Se você está entrando agora no mundo da tecnologia, provavelmente já ouviu falar da Amazon Web Services (AWS). Mas afinal, por onde começar?

Essa foi exatamente a pergunta que eu me fiz quando decidi aprender sobre computação em nuvem.

latest.title: Como a certificação AWS pode transformar sua carreira em TI
latest.description: Se você busca se destacar na tecnologia, sabe que o mercado exige mais que programar. As empresas estão procurando profissionais habilitados para escalar aplicações, garantir segurança e reduzir custos. É aqui que entra a Amazon Web Services (AWS). Uma plataforma de nuvem líder mundial, saber AWS não é apenas um diferencial no currículo, é um passaporte para as melhores oportunidades. A melhor forma de mostrar esse domínio é com as certificações oficiais, que mostram seu conhecimento e capacidade técnica.

latest.title: Startups Building Agents for Healthcare
latest.description: This event brings together founders and engineers developing AI agents that tackle healthcare's administrative challenges, from clinical documentation to insurance workflows. Attendees will hear from industry leaders, see products in action, and network with peers who are reshaping how healthcare operates through intelligent automation.

latest.title: 🚀 5 AWS Services Every College Student Should Know (Before Graduating)
latest.description: This article highlights the 5 most important AWS services every college student should learn to build real-world cloud projects. Instead of focusing on theory or multiple courses, it emphasizes hands-on learning using core AWS services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and IAM. A practical roadmap is included to help beginners start building immediately.

latest.title: Why Cloud Computing Is Built on Scalability
latest.description: Scalability is what lets cloud apps handle anything, from a few users to millions, without crashing or wasting resources.

latest.title: Building a Production-Grade Multi-Agent Platform with Zero Trust Governance on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
latest.description: Enterprise AI agents without governance are insider threats that never sleep. We built a hierarchical multi-agent platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that enforces Zero Trust on every tool call, deploys new agent versions with automatic rollback, detects rogue agents in real time, and produces compliance-ready audit trails for ITAR/EAR environments. Here's how.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Global Impact AI Navigator
trending.description: Global Impact AI Navigator (GIAN) is a multi-agent AI platform built on Amazon Bedrock that transforms a raw idea into a complete strategic package in under 60 seconds — SWOT diagnostic, live-grounded funding discovery, personalized roadmap, and a context-aware advisor. Designed for innovators in emerging markets, it democratizes access to the strategic guidance that usually requires expensive consultants or elite networks.
